title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go V2 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit 2pk
description: The Vaporesso DOJO 2000 GO Transparent Kit combines ease of use with dependable performance in a stylish compact design. The device features a colourful matte metallic finish, while the transparent pod lets you easily keep track of your e-liquid level. The kit includes a 700mAh rechargeable battery paired with a 1ml prefilled pod and a 3ml refill container (4ml total), delivering up to 2,000 puffs in a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) style. COREX BLAST heating ensures steady flavour and vapour throughout, and the inhale-activated draw means there are no buttons or settings to adjust. This twin-pack bundle provides two complete DOJO 2000 GO kits in one box, offering twice the convenience and superb value for everyday vapers or those who like to keep a spare device at the ready. A three-colour LED indicates battery status, and USB-C charging allows quick top-ups between sessions (cable not included). Powered by COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil Technology, the Dojo Blast 2000 Go enhances flavour delivery, vapour consistency, and coil longevity. The inhale-activated, button-free design makes operation effortless—simply attach a pod and draw to vape. When a pod is depleted, easily swap it out for a fresh Dojo Blast 2000 Go Prefilled Pod+Refill Pack, available in a wide selection of 15 bold and exciting flavours. If you’d like to explore more devices like this, check out our full range of Prefilled Pod Vapes to find other convenient, high-quality kits and flavours. The Vaporesso Dojo Blast 2000 Go is the ideal choice for vapers seeking the ease of single-use disposables with the added benefit of a rechargeable device and swappable pods.
